text:
This is a square white plate, roughly 24 cm across. It holds a pile of arugula or spinach-type greens with a light dressing and a few pine nuts. The pile is loose and airy. I estimate about 60 g of greens, plus roughly 10 g of dressing and nuts, for about 70 g total. Greens are about 25 kcal per 100 g, so they contribute around 15 kcal. The dressing, which is probably oil-based, adds about 50 kcal, and the pine nuts add about 20 kcal, for roughly 85 kcal overall.
